bio: If you’re looking for a good Japanese restaurant, this option in the Salamanca district of the city, with its impeccable contemporary ambience, won’t disappoint, given that it follows the same successful recipe as its sister franchises in Marbella and Málaga. It features a sushi bar, two dining rooms on different floors and a private room in which guests can order from an extensive à la carte featuring some of the restaurant’s signature recipes alongside the group’s most iconic dishes. This is complemented by the Matsuri set menu. Although not part of the menu, a selection of hot and cold nigiri are also available....
